title: Analysis code for: Cell composition accounts for much of the transcriptomic difference between failed and matured human arteriovenous fistulas

creators.name: Tang, Yuewu

description:
Pre-specified reanalysis of public human arteriovenous fistula single-cell and bulk RNA-sequencing data (GSE305423, GSE220796, GSE119296). The repository contains the analysis pipeline, fixed random seed (2611), pinned environment, all result tables cited in the article, and a numeric-provenance assertion script that re-derives every number quoted in the manuscript from the result files.

Main findings: apparent transcriptional signatures of maturation failure are dominated by changes in cell composition (including ambient-RNA-driven artefacts) rather than cell-intrinsic reprogramming; myofibroblast abundance, fate bias and matrisome programmes are unchanged within the detectable effect range.
notes: Random seed 2611. Environment pinned in environment.yml. Code licence MIT; source data remain under their original GEO terms.
